description: Dual Connectivity. Double The Sound. With a strong magnetic design, play it your way. Use it as one powerful speaker or split it into two for a wider, more immersive sound experience. Seamless Wireless Experience. Powered by Bluetooth v5.0, enjoy quick pairing and a stable connection for smooth, uninterrupted playback—whether you’re streaming music, watching videos, or more. One Speaker. Three Experiences. Three ways to play. One powerful magnetic design.1) Stack Mode: Amplified vertical sound for powerful output. 2)Horizontal Mode: Balanced stereo experience in a single unit. 3)Stereo Mode: Split into two for true left-right channel separation. Switch modes effortlessly to match your vibe. Up To 8 Hours Playtime. Designed to keep up with your day. Get up to 8 hours of playback on a single charge, so your music keeps going without interruptions. IPX5 Water Resistance. Built for real-life moments, including everyday spills and splashes. Whether you’re by the pool or caught in light rain, the Magneto Duo keeps playing without worry. *This Reconnect Bluetooth Speaker images is for illustration purpose only.
